source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Larry,

Thank you for sending the updated photo. This is helpful and it's good to see the progress.

At this point I'd really like to see the machine operating. As we've discussed, functionality is my highest priority.

When possible, please send a video showing:

• Both stations operating
• Matcha being mixed
• Variable speed operation
• Pouring or dispensing if applicable
• Any remaining items that still need to be completed before shipment

Once I can verify the mechanical operation, we can focus on finalizing the remaining pieces and getting the prototype shipped.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey Karla. The machine is sturdy and everything functions as expected. I had a leak in a piece of the plumbing during testing that I need to get fixed.

execution.observed_behavior: In response to the requested demonstration of both stations operating, the freelancer claims that the machine functions as expected.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks for the update. I'm glad to hear the machine is sturdy and that the core functionality is working as expected.

Please repair the plumbing leak and send me a complete demonstration video once it's fixed.

In the video, I'd like to see:

Both stations operating simultaneously.
Speed adjustment working.
Continuous operation for several minutes.
Water flowing through both plumbing systems without leaks.
Dispensing through both spouts.
Startup and shutdown sequence.

Assuming everything operates properly, I'd also like a shipping date so we can move into the next phase of the project.

routing_warnings.description: The reported plumbing leak is concrete runtime-failure evidence for the leak-free liquid-containment Requirement.
